name: onestep-decks
title_zh: CEO 口吻与公司版式自动合一的融资路演生成器
tagline_zh: 给 OneStep 做路演、董事会、全员会、销售提案。不用再对着旧 PPT 猜版式。
tagline_en: Fundraising, LP, board, all-hands, sales decks for OneStep. No more guessing slide styles or rewriting drafts to.
desc_en: Build presentation decks for OneStep in the CEO's voice and the company's slide design system — fundraising/investor decks, LP/annual-meeting decks, board updates, company all-hands, conference talks, and client/prospect sales decks (senior living, med device, RBOs). Use this skill WHENEVER the user asks for a deck, presentation, slides, pitch, talk, all-hands, QBR, board update, sales deck, or in
why_zh: 版式与语气不是两套工序，而是同一套约束。它把 CEO 的说话方式和公司 slide 规范绑进同一个生成…
why_en: Voice and layout are one constraint set, not two passes. It binds CEO phrasing to the slide spec so decks come out ready, not.
limit_zh: 只认 OneStep 自家设计系统与 CEO 语料；外部品牌或非指定场景（如教学课件、通用 pitch）会硬套模板。
limit_en: Only OneStep's design system and CEO corpus. Outside brands or off-scope formats (e.g., courseware, generic pitches) get force-fitted and need.
title_en: OneStep decks in CEO voice, on-brand slide system
